subject: physical-education
title: Unit assessment: cycling or trail safety
essentialQuestion: How can understanding outdoor recreation and navigation help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
privacySafeScenario: Plan and, where feasible, complete a safe accessible outdoor recreation experience.
studentTask: Complete the unit assessment evidence for cycling or trail safety independently. Supports may preserve access but may not supply the answer, interpretation, or final product.
knowledgeCheck: Rate confidence in cycling or trail safety, cite one piece of evidence from today, and choose: ready to extend, ready to review later, or need a different explanation.
completionCriteria: The learner completes the central task about cycling or trail safety.
The learner gives evidence, reasoning, a model, or a documented process rather than an unsupported answer.
The learner checks or revises the work and can identify a next step.
adaptationChoices: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required. Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model. Allow typed, handwritten, spoken, drawn, manipulatives-based, or demonstrated responses when the standard permits. Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, movement-break, and low-distraction options. Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media. Preserve the learning target while adjusting quantity, pacing, representation, or response mode.
extensionChallenge: Apply cycling or trail safety under a new constraint, compare two approaches or perspectives, or teach the idea with an original example without completing another learner’s graded work.

optionalReflection.prompt: Invite the learner to notice one safe, optional example of cycling or trail safety in daily life. No purchase, account creation, photograph, or private disclosure is required.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
